label: When family pressure feels heavy
title: When family pressure feels heavy
intro: Families care, and sometimes that care feels like pressure. You can be kind and still keep decisions between you and your partner.
steps: Set a boundary kindly and calmly.
Remember that decisions belong to you and your partner.
A counsellor can help with family conversations too, and can join one if you'd like.
phrases: We're taking advice and we'll decide together in our own time.
I know you care. Please trust us with this.
Would you like to come to a counselling session with us?

drafts.detail: I know you care about us, and we're grateful. We've had our screening results explained and we're talking with a qualified counsellor. Decisions like this belong to the two of us, and we'll make them in our own time. If you'd like to understand more, you're welcome to join a counselling session with us.
